messages.subject: gridlines theme_bw()
parts:
Hej, I was wondering is there a possibility to increase the thickness of the gridlines when using theme_bw(). They look very thin when printing the plot.

Thanks!

/Inga

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: gridlines theme_bw()
parts:
Increase the size element of panel.grid.major:

DF <- data.frame(x = rnorm(10), y = rnorm(10))

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(DF, aes(x = x, y = y)) + theme_bw() + geom_point()
p

p + theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 1))

If that isn't thick enough, increase the size value.

Dennis
